question: After a big Nasdaq fall, what does India do next?
method:
us_shock_study.py - "After a big Nasdaq fall, what does India do next?" (desk order 21 Nov 2026 09:45). Pure code, no AI calls, research only.

DATA   Yahoo chart API daily bars (period1/period2, interval=1d - range=max silently returns MONTHLY bars, so it is not used), saved untouched in
       /home/globalbot/girdata/ext/us_shock_study/raw/ and read as data only. India daily: Kite day candles (history/ix_*.npz, exchange data,
       Nov 2021 ->) where they exist, Yahoo before that. NIFTY PVT BANK has no usable Yahoo history (1 bar) -> Kite only (Nov 2021 ->).
       Minutes open -> day's low: /mnt/.../gir/hist_fresh/min/{NIFTY,BANKNIFTY}.npz (UTC epoch 'ts', Nov 2023 -> 19 Nov 2026) and
       girdata/minute/<day>/<IX>__ix.npz ('t' = IST wall clock, Oct 2026 ->).
EVENT  US session D with Nasdaq Composite close <= -3% vs the previous US close (subset <= -4.5%); separately S&P 500 <= -2.5%.
       India 'day-of' = the last India session on or before D (it closed before the US fell). India 'next' N = the first India session after D.
       P = India close of the session before N. Weekend India sessions (Muhurat / special Saturdays) are left out of the calendar.
       If two US dates map to the same N (India holiday), the later US date is kept.
SPLITS (a) D is a Friday; (b) India day-of closed up; (c) the US session before D also closed down (same index as the event set);
       (d) Asia down: any of Nikkei / KOSPI / Taiwan / Hang Seng closed <= -3% on N's calendar date (primary; NOTE Asia closes 11:00-13:40 IST,
       so this is only partly known at India's open); (d2) the same test on D's calendar date (fully known before India's open).
  python3 us_shock_study.py fetch   -> download raw (market closed only)
  python3 us_shock_study.py         -> report .md + .json and the lesson file

friday.label: (a) Friday US fall -> next India session (Monday)

india_up.label: (b) India closed UP on the US-fall day

india_down.label: India closed down/flat on the US-fall day

two_down.label: (c) two US down days in a row

one_down.label: the US day before was up
